raw_segments.text: Listen! Legally he owes me nothing. I've had it all from him, I know that. But morally
he owes me something, doesn't he? You know he started with twenty-eight thousand of my
mother's money and made a hundred thousand with it. Let him give me back only three out
of the twenty-eight thousand, and he'll draw my soul out of hell, and it will atone for
many of his sins. For that three thousand, I give you my solemn word. I'll make an end
of everything, and he shall hear nothing more of me.
For the last time, I give him the chance to be a father. Tell him God himself sends him
